notes: v458 — two things. FIXED: a share's history could stop at the previous session while the main table already showed today's — the amber "today's session isn't loaded" banner on a day it plainly was. The saved history recorded the day it was written, and the app read that as proof of what was inside it, so an early-morning save made yesterday's rows look current all day. It now checks the newest bar itself, and fills in the missing day from the quote already on screen — no extra download. NEW: two turnover tiles on the Market Radar under Volume — $250k+ Traded and $1M+ Traded — showing how many shares actually had that much value change hands today (close x volume). Tap to filter, tap again to clear, and stack them with the other tiles as usual. A liquidity check, not advice. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
